title: Technical review
purpose: Find batches containing submitted results and see which work is independent of your own entry/submission.
summary: Find the batches with results submitted for review, and see how many of them you may review yourself.

tasks.title: Review a batch
steps: Find a batch with work in You may review. The oldest submission is listed first.
Select the batch number to open its review page.

good_to_know: You cannot review results you entered or submitted. The yours count shows them.
You may review counts independence only. It does not mean QC, holding time or preservation are ready.
A batch stays in the queue while its results wait, even if all of them are yours. Another reviewer must decide them.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: These are staff pages. Active users with an application staff role can read them; client accounts cannot. Analysts perform result entry and batch work, reviewers decide results, and administrators maintain configuration. Administrators also have operational analyst and reviewer access, but independence rules still apply. Superuser status alone does not grant an application role.

items.label: Method
items.description: Filter by active exact method/version. There is no free-text search on this queue.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Any matrix, Water, Wastewater or Soil.

items.label: Batch
items.description: Number linking to the batch’s technical review page.

items.label: Awaiting review
items.description: Submitted revisions waiting in the batch.

items.label: You may review
items.description: Submitted revisions you neither entered nor submitted. The adjacent yours count identifies excluded work. This count represents independence, not an assertion that your role or the result’s QC/holding/preservation is ready for approval.

items.label: Oldest submitted
items.description: Oldest pending submission date/time in the batch.

items.label: Open QC findings
items.description: Distinct current unresolved batch QC findings holding affected results. Computed for displayed batches; cannot be sorted.

items.label: Holding issues
items.description: Latest submitted revisions with holding Exceeded or Not evaluable. Computed for displayed batches; cannot be sorted.

items.label: Batch
items.description: Inspect current submitted results, their approval blockers and supporting evidence. Only reviewers may apply decisions; staff readers can inspect the queue.

sections.title: Filtering and table controls

items.label: Apply
items.description: Apply search and filters to the entire matching dataset and return to page 1. Invalid filters show errors and no rows; they never widen the query.

items.label: Clear all
items.description: Remove search and filters and restore this page’s defaults. A filter chip removes only that filter.

items.label: Rows per page
items.description: Choose 25 (default), 50 or 100. First, Previous, Next and Last page links retain filters. Counts describe all matching records.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Show or hide optional columns and change their order using movement controls or header dragging. Changes apply immediately and are saved for this table in your account, on any workstation. Locked columns stay available.

items.label: Reset columns
items.description: Restore the original column visibility and order. Done or Close dismisses the Columns dialog.

paragraphs: Oldest submission first by default. Batch, Awaiting review and Oldest submitted headings sort the whole filtered queue. There is no selection or cross-batch decision on this page.

sections.title: Empty states
paragraphs: Nothing is awaiting review means no submitted revisions are pending. Analysts must first save entries, inspect them and submit. A filtered empty result offers Clear all. A batch can remain in the queue even if all its work is yours; another qualified reviewer must decide it.
